title: Plugin hooks never fire because hooks.json lacks the top-level "hooks" key
symptoms: Plugin is enabled but none of its hooks run
A hooks file that starts with {"PostToolUse": [...]} fails to load
cause: A hooks file, including the plugin's hooks/hooks.json, must wrap the event map in a top-level "hooks" key, and a bare event map fails to load. Inline hooks inside plugin.json are the opposite: the event map with no wrapper.
fix: Wrap the event map in a hooks key, then run claude plugin validate on the plugin folder.
